messages:
anna: Heads up — pen test vendor is ready to start staging scan next Tue 03:00 UTC. Need final scope + evidence handoff plan. Can we confirm RBAC changes, KMS access, and logs they need?

jess: Thanks. Outline we need: 1) exact staging targets 2) who/what accounts will be tested 3) temporary RBAC perms + expiration 4) KMS key access method 5) audit log export path.

anna: Draft scope attached in the drive: https://drive.redwood/pt/staging-scope-draft — includes the app cluster, console, and telemetry endpoints. Not including prod.

jess: OK. @mike pls confirm how we grant the vendor ephemeral RBAC and KMS access. Prefer timeboxed service account + key encryption via KMS. Also want signed evidence bundle format.

mike: We can provision a short-lived service account in staging with scoped roles (read-only + exploit testing allowed). Use IAM token TTL 4h, rotated by our infra bot. For KMS: we will create a grant to allow ``cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt`` on the test key for vendor SA — revokes after 24h. Docs: https://go.redwood/kms-grants

anna: Perfect. Can you also add an audit log sink to a read-only bucket for the duration? Need 90d retention for the evidence.

tom: We should ship a filtered audit log export with the following fields: timestamp, principal, action, resource, request_id. SIEM team can pull from the bucket. We'll enable object versioning while tests run. Suggest 90d retention min.

jess: I'll create the intake ticket and template for evidence. Template will require: scanned targets, PoC steps, time windows (UTC), log manifests, signed checksums.

sec-bot: Automated: SEC-TICKET-3421 created by jess — intake + remediation tracker. Link: https://redwood.sec/SEC-3421

anna: For remediation tracking: want weekly sync + a Jira with story per vuln and a blocker flag for anything with RCE or exposed keys. Can we tag owners automatically?

jess: Yes — we'll map codeowner teams to Jira components. I'll add a small script for triage mapping. Pseudocode we can run post-report:

```
# triage-mapper.sh (simple)
# input: vuln_id, path
owner=$(git blame --line-porcelain $path | sed -n '1p' | awk '{print $2}')
jira create --component $owner --summary "PT vuln $vuln_id"
```

mike: For evidence collection: run the following on each test node and upload to bucket:

```
sudo tar -czf /tmp/node-logs-$(date -Iseconds).tar.gz /var/log/redwood /opt/redwood/kvcache/logs
sha256sum /tmp/node-logs-*.tar.gz > /tmp/logs.sha256
gsutil cp /tmp/node-logs-*.tar.gz gs://redwood-pt-evidence/$JOB_ID/
gsutil cp /tmp/logs.sha256 gs://redwood-pt-evidence/$JOB_ID/
```

anna: Great. What about retest windows? Vendor asks for retest 2 weeks after evidence handoff. Is that acceptable?

jess: Sounds fine. We'll default to 2 weeks for low/med severity, 48-72h for critical after patch deployed. Add that to the SLA in the intake ticket.

tom: One more — ensure we rotate any transient creds issued to vendor immediately after testing and confirm via audit log. I can add an automated job to verify revocation and post a digest to the ticket.

anna: OK, I'm going to finalize the scope and handoff doc and post in the ticket. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Automated: Evidence bucket gs://redwood-pt-evidence created, retention=90d, versioning=enabled."
